description: This file implements a configuration and interface for integrating RunwayML's Text-to-Speech API into a larger system. It defines classes and methods for configuring requests, mapping parameters from OpenAI to RunwayML, handling API environment validation, managing asynchronous and synchronous polling of task status, and processing responses to obtain audio data.

classes.name: RunwayMLTextToSpeechConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for the RunwayML Text-to-Speech API, providing methods for request dispatching, parameter mapping, environment validation, and response transformation.

methods.name: Union["HttpxBinaryResponseContent",Coroutine[Any,Any,"HttpxBinaryResponseContent"],] dispatch_text_to_speech( self, model: str, input: str, voice: Optional[Union[str, Dict]], optional_params: Dict, litellm_params_dict: Dict, logging_obj: "LiteLLMLoggingObj", timeout: Union[float, httpx.Timeout], extra_headers: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], base_llm_http_handler: Any, aspeech: bool, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], **kwargs: Any, )
methods.description: Handles the creation and dispatch of a TTS request to RunwayML, resolving credentials and API parameters, and invoking the HTTP handler.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns the list of OpenAI parameters supported by RunwayML TTS ('voice').

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Dict] map_openai_params( self, model: str, optional_params: Dict, voice: Optional[Union[str, Dict]] = None, drop_params: bool = False, kwargs: Dict = {}, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI TTS parameters to RunwayML-specific parameters, mainly converting voice names to dict formats.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and sets up authorization headers for the RunwayML API environment.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, model: str, api_base: Optional[str], litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for the RunwayML TTS API request based on the environment and model.

methods.name: None _check_timeout(start_time: float, timeout_secs: float)
methods.description: Checks if a polling operation has exceeded the specified timeout.

methods.name: str _check_task_status(response_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Analyzes the task status response from RunwayML to determine if the task succeeded, failed, or is still running.

methods.name: httpx.Response _poll_task_sync( self, task_id: str, api_base: str, headers: Dict[str, str], timeout_secs: float = 600, )
methods.description: Synchronously polls RunwayML until the task is complete or times out.

methods.name: httpx.Response _poll_task_async( self, task_id: str, api_base: str, headers: Dict[str, str], timeout_secs: float = 600, )
methods.description: Asynchronously polls RunwayML until the task is complete or times out.

methods.name: TextToSpeechRequestData transform_text_to_speech_request( self, model: str, input: str, voice: Optional[Union[str, Dict]], optional_params: Dict, litellm_params: Dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms the input text and parameters into the JSON body required by RunwayML TTS API.

methods.name: "HttpxBinaryResponseContent" transform_text_to_speech_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: "LiteLLMLoggingObj", )
methods.description: Processes the initial response, polls for task completion, and retrieves the generated audio, returning it as binary content.

methods.name: "HttpxBinaryResponseContent" async_transform_text_to_speech_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: "LiteLLMLoggingObj", )
methods.description: Asynchronous version of response transformation, including async polling and download.
